mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_payment_config WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_payment_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_payment_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_config (user_id, payment_type, alipay_account, real_name, is_default, status, create_time, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{paymentType}, #{alipayAccount}, #{realName}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_config SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_payment_config SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND is_default = 1
